fields.label: Action
fields.help: The Action to perform when the client connection triggers the rule.

fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Description
fields.help: An optional description for this resource.

fields.label: Direction
fields.help: The direction in which this rule applies.

fields.label: Disabled
fields.help: Denotes whether the firewall policy rule is disabled.

fields.label: Enable Logging
fields.help: Denotes whether to enable logging for a particular rule.

fields.label: Firewall Policy
fields.help: The firewall policy of the resource.

fields.label: Priority
fields.help: An integer indicating the priority of a rule in the list.

fields.label: Region
fields.help: The location of this resource.

fields.label: Rule Name
fields.help: An optional name for the rule.

fields.label: Security Profile Group
fields.help: A fully-qualified URL of a SecurityProfile resource instance.

fields.label: Target Forwarding Rules
fields.help: A list of forwarding rules to which this rule applies.

fields.label: Target Service Accounts
fields.help: A list of service accounts indicating the sets of instances that are applied with this rule.

fields.label: Target Type
fields.help: Target types of the firewall policy rule.

fields.label: TLS Inspect
fields.help: Boolean flag indicating if the traffic should be TLS decrypted.

fields.label: Match
Dest Address Groups
fields.help: Address groups which should be matched against the traffic destination.

fields.label: Dest Fqdns
fields.help: Fully Qualified Domain Name (FQDN) which should be matched against traffic destination.

fields.label: Dest IP Ranges
fields.help: CIDR IP address range.

fields.label: Dest Network Context
fields.help: Network context of the traffic destination.

fields.label: Dest Region Codes
fields.help: Region codes whose IP addresses will be used to match for destination of traffic.

fields.label: Dest Threat Intelligences
fields.help: Names of Network Threat Intelligence lists.

fields.label: Src Address Groups
fields.help: Address groups which should be matched against the traffic source.

fields.label: Src Fqdns
fields.help: Fully Qualified Domain Name (FQDN) which should be matched against traffic source.

fields.label: Src IP Ranges
fields.help: CIDR IP address range.

fields.label: Src Network Context
fields.help: Network context of the traffic source.

fields.label: Src Networks
fields.help: Networks of the traffic source.

fields.label: Src Region Codes
fields.help: Region codes whose IP addresses will be used to match for source of traffic.

fields.label: Src Threat Intelligences
fields.help: Names of Network Threat Intelligence lists.

fields.label: Layer4 Configs
IP Protocol
fields.help: The IP protocol to which this rule applies.

fields.label: Ports
fields.help: An optional list of ports to which this rule applies.
Pairs of IP protocols and ports that the rule should match.

fields.label: Src Secure Tags
Name
fields.help: Name of the secure tag, created with TagManager's TagValue API.
List of secure tag values, which should be matched at the source of the traffic.
A match condition that incoming traffic is evaluated against.

fields.label: Target Secure Tags
Name
fields.help: Name of the secure tag, created with TagManager's TagValue API.
A list of secure tags that controls which instances the firewall rule applies to.
